claims: Michigan defeated Arizona 91-73 in the 2026 Men's Final Four on April 4, 2026.
Michigan advanced to the national championship.
The game was at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana.
Michigan advances to the NCAA Tournament championship game to play UConn on April 6.
Arizona set a new school record for wins in a season.
Michigan took a 26-10 lead in the first 10 minutes.
Aday Mara scored 15 points in the first half for Michigan.
Aday Mara scored 26 points for Michigan.
Michigan led by 30 in the second half.
Trey McKenney scored 16 points for Michigan.
Elliot Cadeau had 13 points and 10 assists for Michigan.
Yaxel Lendeborg of Michigan returned to the game after an ankle scare in the first half.
